_comment: The EXACT set of OpenAPI 3.1 nullable-reference properties (`oneOf: [{$ref}, {type: null}]`)
that ../normalize-openapi.py is allowed to shim into an optional `$ref` in the
v1-operator-mobile contract. The transform fails loud unless the contract's set matches this
file exactly, so a contract change surfaces here for deliberate review instead of being
silently normalized. Each entry is the owning component schema, the property, and the target.
When a legitimate contract change adds or removes one, update this file AND the wrapper models

nullableRefs.note: A4.6 server-side symbolication block; an unarmed host serializes explicit null.
Absent when the issue id resolves to nothing visible.
Null for a release with no linked changelog entry.
Null when the trials module is not enabled for the project.
M6.5 typed allow-listed timeline metadata; an unknown-kind event serializes null.
M6.2 server-authorized {kind,id} routing token; null when no source is reachable.
